title: GET https://api-ar-game.bistudio.com/game-api/api/v1.0/dummy
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 four times: 200 with an empty object as the body, and no credential of any kind - no accessToken, no x-client-id, no x-client-secret, only `accept: */*`, `content-type: application/json` and the user agent. It is sent one second before rooms/acceptPlayer when a player joins and one second before rooms/removePlayer when he leaves, and once on shutdown before rooms/remove, which is why it reads as the server checking that the backend is reachable before committing something. What it actually does was not established.

response.description: The captured body is exactly {} - 2 bytes.
